Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: P0 alert — GCP internal load balancer control plane showing degraded routes. Private VPC cross-region routing failures observed for multiple customers (initial) — paging on-call. thread_ts=1712223333

Maria Chen: I’m on it. Which regions are affected? Seeing spikes in 5xx from our private endpoints in us-east1 -> us-west1 cross-region requests.

Kevin Liu: Confirmed. 502/504s for internal endpoints that route via our cross-region ILB. Ran a quick curl against a private endpoint via bastion in us-east1 and got TCP RST intermittently.

Raj Patel: I’m checking GCP status. GCP Status Bot reports "Intermittent networking issue affecting Internal Load Balancer control plane in several regions" — link: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/abcd-1234 (GCP page shows incident since ~10m ago).

Samir Desai: Reproduced traceroute from us-east1 -> internal-lb-ip: path drops after GCP edge (AS15169). Looks like control plane reroutes failing; health checks are flapping. Health check logs: ``gcloud compute health-checks describe redwood-private-hc --region=us-west1`` shows repeated timeout at 10:12-10:18.

Emily Novak: Customer impact: two Private VPC customers on cross-region routing (acct-acme-maps, acct-fintrust) report increased errors in their apps. CS has opened CS-789 and CS-790. AcmeMaps reports 20% error rate on map tile rendering.

Maria Chen: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Disable cross-region routing override for affected customer groups and force regional routing (fail traffic to same-region backends) via redwood control plane. 2) If that doesn't stabilize, switch those customers to Dedicated fallback pool in-region for critical paths. 3) Keep customers informed.

Kevin Liu: Applying routing override now for acct-acme-maps and acct-fintrust. Command: ``redwoodctl private routing set --customer acct-acme-maps,acct-fintrust --prefer-region=local --reason "GCP ILB control plane degradation"``

Kevin Liu: (follow-up) routing set acknowledged by control plane, pushed to edge proxies. Monitoring metrics now.

Raj Patel: Rolling check: using bastion in us-east1, re-running curl tests. Before: 502. After routing change: curl responses return 200 for 10/10 requests from us-east1 to local backends, still seeing failures for us-east1->us-west1 cross-region async jobs (non-critical batch).

Samir Desai: Good. We're reducing customer visible errors for synchronous flows. For background cross-region replication jobs, suggest disabling cross-region queueing until GCP fixes underlying control plane. I’ll add a job toggle in the private-agent.

Emily Novak: Notifying customers now: posting to CS tickets and sending a short status note: "We’ve implemented a regional routing override to mitigate cross-region failures. Some background replication may be delayed. We're monitoring and will update."

GCP Status Bot: Update from GCP (10:27): "Mitigation in progress, engineering continues to investigate control plane network routing issue. Users may experience intermittent connectivity to ILB-managed hosts across regions"

Maria Chen: Can we measure impacted %? Kevin, Samir — give me numbers so I can include in incident brief.

Kevin Liu: From metrics: AcmeMaps error-rate dropped from 22% -> 3% for foreground requests after override. FinTrust dropped from 15% -> 2%. Cross-region batch failures still ~40% for queued jobs.

Samir Desai: Implemented temporary job toggle for cross-region queues (disabled) and backfilled local-only processing. Patch deployed at 10:32. Logs: ``private-agent: queue_dispatch skipped cross-region route for acct-fintrust``.

Raj Patel: I’m adding a note in the incident board: INC-2026-3456 (GCP ILB control plane impacting Private VPC cross-region). Logged initial timeline, customers affected, mitigations applied.

Maria Chen: Good. Action items: 1) Keep monitoring for 30m. 2) If GCP clears, we will slowly re-enable cross-region routing and monitor. 3) Prepare handoff notes for next on-call.

Kevin Liu: Metrics continuing to look stable for foreground traffic. I’ll set an alarm if error rate >5% for any private-customer route.

Emily Novak: CS updated both customers with the mitigation note and ETA for next update (in 30m). They asked for a postmortem — please collect logs.

Samir Desai: Collecting packet captures and health-check logs now (saving to gcs://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-3456/). Command used: ``gcloud compute forwarding-rules list --filter="region~us-" && gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-private-um --global``

GCP Status Bot: Update (10:40): "Control plane mitigation showing improvement, continued monitoring advised."

Maria Chen: Preparing handoff. Key points for next on-call: - Incident INC-2026-3456, started 1712223333. - Mitigation: regional routing override applied for acct-acme-maps and acct-fintrust at 1712223392. - Foreground error rates down to low single digits; background cross-region queueing disabled and backfilled. - Logs & pcaps at gcs://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-3456/. - Customer comms done. - Next steps: coordinate with GCP to validate control plane heals before re-enabling cross-region routing; plan for a controlled re-enable with canary at 5% traffic.

Raj Patel: Handoff ack. I’ll be on for the next 12h and will monitor. I’ll escalate to GCP account rep if status regresses.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Leaving on-call: handing to Raj. :white_check_mark:

Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded — new on-call: Raj Patel. Incident remains P0. Next update scheduled in 30m.
